title: govwin Role Guides
lede: Three indexed, screenshot-grounded walkthroughs — one per role. Every step is anchored to a real route and a real tool, captured from a live end-to-end run (the Immobileyes NAVAIR/NAVSEA Counter-UAS SBIR, topic DON26BX03-NP002).
footer: Each guide is generated from an editable JSON content file in docs/manuals/guides/ — change the data, re-run docs/manuals/build_guides.py, and the HTML + PDF regenerate. govwin, 2026.

guides.blurb: Every screen in the admin console, step by step: monitor sources, ingest and curate RFPs, push opportunities, release purchases, and oversee every workflow and agent.
Every feature of your portal, step by step: rank opportunities, build a content library, draft from your atoms in the canvas, lock the matrix, and export submission-ready files.
Invited to a single proposal, scoped to what you're granted: accept, contribute in the canvas, comment, and see exactly what each grant unlocks (full permission matrix).
